summary: Frontend-only verification of new centered editorial hero + global font swap. All requested checks pass. Landing (/) renders new hero (masthead, eyebrow, h1, paragraph, CTAs, log-in link, stat ledger). HeroProductShowcase renders inside a dark stage with browser-chrome window. Tabs interview/model/document switch the mock (mock-interview-ui / excel-model-ui / doc-sim-ui) and the URL pill text (valuevade.com/interview/live -> /session/dcf-build -> /simulation/annual-report). Auto-rotation confirmed: interview auto-switched to model within 7.5s. After a manual click, no further auto-rotation observed for 8s. No horizontal overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth = 1920 at 1920x1080 and 390 at 390x844 (any child elements exceeding 390 are the intentional lv-ticker-track marquee children as noted). CTAs: hero-primary-cta -> /signup, hero-secondary-cta -> /course/5f69ef74-9bff-4cb7-9b5d-68a82d9aad5c, hero-signup-link -> /login. Global font swap verified: body = Instrument Sans, h1/h2/h3 = Newsreader on /, /login, /signup, and /dashboard (after logging in as testagent2026@gmail.com). No Inter / Space Grotesk / Bricolage / Clash Display / Fraunces / JetBrains Mono strings observed as active font-family. No console errors captured during traversal.

issues: Elements without an explicit var(--font-mono) / .lv-folio class fall back to ui-monospace instead of Spline Sans Mono. This is acceptable per current CSS (mono is applied only where explicitly used) but worth noting if the intent is a truly site-wide mono swap for <code>/<pre> tags.

critical_code_review_comments: HeroProductShowcase auto-rotate correctly stops on manual tab click via setAuto(false) — verified live.

Fonts loaded via a single Google Fonts <link> in public/index.html (Instrument Sans + Newsreader + Spline Sans Mono). Body and h1/h2/h3 rules in index.css cascade globally — no per-page overrides observed.
